<size=+4><align="center">New Tempering Workshop</align></size>
<size=+4><align="center">Opening soon!</align></size>

<align="center">Dear fellow vagrants, good day!</align>
<align="center">I am Oggla Clark of Rivet Town.</align>
<align="center">You may not have heard of me, but you probably have heard of the Tempering Workshop in Rivet Town.</align>
<align="center">That's right! I hail from this legendary workshop!</align>

<align="center">Rivet Town has completely fallen to the invasion of Fragmentum Monsters, and the old Tempering Workshop has disbanded because of that.</align>
<align="center">Even as I arrive at this vagrant camp, I am unable to locate my former colleagues.</align>
<align="center">However, there are a number of able craftspeople among the vagrant community, and we have hit it off right away.</align>
<align="center">Therefore, I have decided to inherit the name of the beloved Tempering Workshop by founding the</align>
<align="center">New Tempering Workshop!</align>

<align="center">Services provided:</align>
<align="center">Appraisal, repairing, and recycling of various ancient relics</align>
<align="center">Recycling and refurbishment of old parts</align>
<align="center">Sale of various spare parts</align>

<align="center">We hope all fellow vagrants pay attention to the fact that the supply of goods in the workshop does not come from conventional channels.</align>
<align="center">All of the parts we have are sourced from putting in hard work and risking our lives in the machine graveyard. </align>
<align="center">Each and every one of them has a soul and is infused with our heart and persistence!</align>
<align="center">Even though some may complain about the appearance and variety of our wares,</align>
<align="center">You will be hard-pressed to find another establishment like ours!</align>

<align="center">So what are you waiting for?</align>
<align="center">Take action rather than take fancy!</align>
<align="center">Come to the New Tempering Workshop and look for the gadgets of your dreams!</align>
<align="center">Come with your robot friend and enjoy a <unbreak>50%</unbreak> discount!</align>
